POP series

POP Series 5

Released March 1, 2007 · 17 cards

POP Series 5 is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the POP series, released in English on March 1, 2007. It has 17 cards. It includes 12 Pokémon, 2 Trainer and 3 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

8 illustrators worked on POP Series 5. Most cards: Mitsuhiro Arita (6), Masakazu Fukuda (3), Ryo Ueda (2), Takumi Akabane (2), Ken Sugimori (1), Kouki Saitou (1), Naoyo Kimura (1), Shin-ichi Yoshikawa (1).
